title: Portable Nether Portal
description: This mod adds a teleportation item to the Nether.
body:
## Portable Nether Portal

- This mod adds an item that allows the player to teleport to the Nether with a right click.
- The item retains the basic coordinate system in the Nether, which will be very useful in helping you move around faster.

## Craft
![craft](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/28f812c0e4abe7576a871c737c3633302ab9ec8b.png)
- 4 Obsidians
- 2 Gold Block
- 2 Diamond Block
- 1 Nether Wart
